instruction: Open the provided init.ifc office layout in Bonsai. Add room finish and area data, save the completed IFC4 model as result.ifc, and export a room finish schedule as result.csv using a Bonsai or IfcCSV-style workflow. The result should contain one project, one building storey, five spaces, seven walls, one slab, four doors, three windows, seven opening elements, seven void relationships, and seven fill relationships. Do not include building element proxies or furnishing elements. Every door and window should fill one opening, and every such opening should void an IfcWall. Name the spaces Lobby, Office A, Office B, Meeting, and WC. Each space should have an EPset_FMFinish property set with RoomNumber, FloorFinish, WallFinish, and CeilingFinish, plus a Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities NetFloorArea quantity. The CSV must use the exact header order RoomNumber, SpaceName, FloorFinish, WallFinish, CeilingFinish, NetFloorArea. It should contain exactly one row for each space, matching the IFC property values and NetFloorArea within 0.05 square meters. Use these required room records: 101 Lobby Polished Concrete Painted GWB Acoustic Tile NetFloorArea 10.08; 102 Office A Carpet Tile Painted GWB Acoustic Tile NetFloorArea 23.04; 103 Office B Carpet Tile Painted GWB Acoustic Tile NetFloorArea 33.84; 104 Meeting Vinyl Plank Painted GWB Acoustic Tile NetFloorArea 14.96; and 105 WC Ceramic Tile Moisture Board Painted Ceiling NetFloorArea 15.64. Other details may vary.
